The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core mathematical implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.75 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.495s. While the logic is sound, the discrepancy between verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for refining edge-case handling or documentation.
